metadata.description: Guardrails for Claude Code that enforce instead of advise.

plugins.name: workproof
plugins.description: A secret guard for shell, Docker and commits; per-project plans whose stages close only on a command that passes; agent roles with model limits; commit rules; a flow map kept true by its tests; a watcher for long runs; and skills for delivery, Docker, Rust and button layout. Every module switches on or off.
